datasets.name: 00f79f70
datasets.displayName: CELL POUR dashboard bloc 333 les dernieres lignes
queryLines:
-- CREATE DASHBOARD: dashboard bloc 333
-- Les requêtes suivantes peuvent être ajoutées comme widgets dans le dashboard "dashboard bloc 333"

-- 1. Nombre total de clients
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_CLIENT_ID) AS total_clients
FROM workspace.gold.dim_clients_gold;

-- 2. Répartition des clients par code postal
SELECT CODE_POSTAL, COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_CLIENT_ID) AS nb_clients
FROM workspace.gold.dim_clients_gold
GROUP BY CODE_POSTAL;

-- 3. Statistiques contrats par type
SELECT TYPE_CONTRAT, COUNT(CONTRAT_ID) AS nb_contrats, SUM(MONTANT_PRIME) AS montant_total
FROM workspace.gold.fact_contrats
GROUP BY TYPE_CONTRAT;

-- 4. Statistiques sinistres & financières
SELECT 
    SUM(c.MONTANT_PRIME) AS chiffre_affaires,
    SUM(s.MONTANT_INDEMNISE) AS indemnites_versees,
    ROUND((SUM(s.MONTANT_INDEMNISE) / SUM(c.MONTANT_PRIME)) * 100, 2) AS ratio_sinistralite_pct
FROM workspace.gold.fact_contrats c
LEFT JOIN workspace.gold.fact_sinistres s 
    ON c.CONTRAT_ID = s.CONTRAT_ID;

/*-- 5. Matrice des doublons
SELECT MASTER_CLIENT_ID, Nom_Hached, Prenom_Hached,  COUNT(*) AS nb_comptes
FROM  workspace.gold.dim_clients_gold -- gold_dim_client
GROUP BY MASTER_CLIENT_ID, Nom_Hached, Prenom_Hached
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
*/
WITH clients_comptes AS (
    SELECT 
        MASTER_CLIENT_ID, 
        Nom_Hached, 
        Prenom_Hached, 
        SOURCE_SYSTEM,
        ORIGINAL_ID,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY MASTER_CLIENT_ID, Nom_Hached, Prenom_Hached) AS nb_comptes
    FROM workspace.gold.dim_clients_gold
)
SELECT 
    MASTER_CLIENT_ID, 
    Nom_Hached, 
    Prenom_Hached, 
    SOURCE_SYSTEM,
    ORIGINAL_ID,
    nb_comptes
FROM clients_comptes
WHERE nb_comptes > 1
ORDER BY MASTER_CLIENT_ID, SOURCE_SYSTEM LIMIT 15;

datasets.name: payments_monthly
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(p.DATE_PAYMENT AS DATE)) AS mois_payment,
  c.TYPE_CONTRAT,
  SUM(p.MONTANT_INDEMNISE) AS montant_total
FROM
  workspace.gold.fact_payments p
    LEFT JOIN workspace.gold.fact_contrats c
      ON p.CONTRAT_ID = c.CONTRAT_ID
GROUP BY
  DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(p.DATE_PAYMENT AS DATE)),
  c.TYPE_CONTRAT
ORDER BY
  mois_payment

datasets.name: sinistres_detail
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.SINISTRE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '****'
  END AS SINISTRE_ID,
  CASE
    WHEN s.CONTRAT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '****'
  END AS CONTRAT_ID,
  c.TYPE_CONTRAT,
  CASE
    WHEN s.MASTER_CLIENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '****'
  END AS MASTER_CLIENT_ID,
  cl.Nom_Hached,
  cl.Prenom_Hached,
  s.MONTANT_INDEMNISE,
  s.STATUT_SINISTRE
FROM
  workspace.gold.fact_sinistres s
    LEFT JOIN workspace.gold.fact_contrats c
      ON s.CONTRAT_ID = c.CONTRAT_ID
    LEFT JOIN workspace.gold.dim_clients_gold cl
      ON c.MASTER_CLIENT_ID = cl.MASTER_CLIENT_ID
WHERE
  c.CONTRAT_ID IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  s.MONTANT_INDEMNISE DESC

datasets.name: contrats_detail
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE 
    WHEN c.CONTRAT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '****' 
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS CONTRAT_ID,
  CASE 
    WHEN c.MASTER_CLIENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '****' 
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS MASTER_CLIENT_ID,
  c.TYPE_CONTRAT,
  cl.Nom_Hached,
  cl.Prenom_Hached,
  cl.CODE_POSTAL,
  c.MONTANT_PRIME,
  c.STATUT_CONTRAT
FROM
  workspace.gold.fact_contrats c
    LEFT JOIN workspace.gold.dim_clients_gold cl
      ON c.MASTER_CLIENT_ID = cl.MASTER_CLIENT_ID -- Utilise toujours les vraies valeurs
ORDER BY
  c.MONTANT_PRIME DESC

datasets.name: payments_detail
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p.PAYMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '****'
  END AS PAYMENT_ID,
  CASE
    WHEN p.CONTRAT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '****'
  END AS CONTRAT_ID,
  c.TYPE_CONTRAT,
  cl.Nom_Hached,
  cl.Prenom_Hached,
  cl.CODE_POSTAL,
  CAST(p.DATE_PAYMENT AS DATE) AS date_payment,
  DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(p.DATE_PAYMENT AS DATE)) AS mois_payment,
  p.MONTANT_INDEMNISE,
  p.MODE_PAYMENT
FROM
  workspace.gold.fact_payments p
    LEFT JOIN workspace.gold.fact_contrats c
      ON p.CONTRAT_ID = c.CONTRAT_ID
    LEFT JOIN workspace.gold.dim_clients_gold cl
      ON c.MASTER_CLIENT_ID = cl.MASTER_CLIENT_ID
WHERE
  c.CONTRAT_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND cl.MASTER_CLIENT_ID IS NOT NULL
